cancelButtonProps.zh-CN: 取消按钮的属性，autoFocus 为 true 时打开后聚焦该按钮，class、style 落在按钮上。
cancelButtonProps.en-US: Props of the cancel button. autoFocus focuses it on open; class and style land on the button.

cancelText.zh-CN: 取消按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Popconfirm.cancel。
cancelText.en-US: Cancel button text. Defaults to the locale entry Popconfirm.cancel.

defaultVisible.zh-CN: 非受控时初始是否展示。
defaultVisible.en-US: Whether it is initially shown when uncontrolled.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用；禁用时只渲染触发元素，不弹出确认框。
disabled.en-US: Whether it is disabled. A disabled Popconfirm renders only the trigger and never opens.

okButtonProps.zh-CN: 确认按钮的属性，autoFocus 为 true 时打开后聚焦该按钮，class、style 落在按钮上。
okButtonProps.en-US: Props of the confirm button. autoFocus focuses it on open; class and style land on the button.

okText.zh-CN: 确认按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Popconfirm.confirm（zh_CN 为「确定」）。
okText.en-US: Confirm button text. Defaults to the locale entry Popconfirm.confirm.

showCloseIcon.zh-CN: 是否显示右上角关闭按钮。
showCloseIcon.en-US: Whether the close button in the corner is shown.

title.zh-CN: 纯文本标题，同时作为对话框的可访问名称；同时传入 #title 插槽时以插槽为准。声明为 prop，不会作为原生 title 属性落到元素上。
title.en-US: Plain-text title, which also names the dialog. The #title slot wins when both are given. It is a declared prop, so it never lands on an element as the native title attribute.

onCancel.zh-CN: 点击取消按钮或关闭按钮的回调；返回 Promise 时按钮保持加载，落定后才关闭，reject 时保留确认框；保留为函数 prop 以读取返回值。
onCancel.en-US: Called when the cancel or close button is clicked. A returned Promise keeps the button loading and closes the card once it resolves; a rejection keeps it open. This remains a function prop so its result can be read.

onConfirm.zh-CN: 点击确认按钮的回调；返回 Promise 时按钮保持加载，落定后才关闭，reject 时保留确认框；保留为函数 prop 以读取返回值。
onConfirm.en-US: Called when the confirm button is clicked. A returned Promise keeps the button loading and closes the card once it resolves; a rejection keeps it open. This remains a function prop so its result can be read.

ariaLabel.zh-CN: 对话框的 aria-label，传入后优先于标题。
ariaLabel.en-US: aria-label of the dialog. When given, it takes precedence over the title.

ariaLabelledby.zh-CN: 对话框的 aria-labelledby，缺省指向标题，没有标题时指向内容。
ariaLabelledby.en-US: aria-labelledby of the dialog. Defaults to the title, or to the content without a title.

ariaDescribedby.zh-CN: 对话框的 aria-describedby，缺省在同时有标题和内容时指向内容。
ariaDescribedby.en-US: aria-describedby of the dialog. Defaults to the content when there are both a title and content.

role.zh-CN: 弹出层的 ARIA role，缺省为 dialog。
role.en-US: ARIA role of the popup. Defaults to dialog.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 弹出层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the popup flips automatically when it would be clipped.

visible.zh-CN: 是否展示，配合 v-model:visible 使用；传入后由该值决定显示，trigger 保持原值，触发器事件仍然生效。
visible.en-US: Whether it is shown, used with v-model:visible. When given, this value decides; trigger keeps its value and the trigger events still work.

position.zh-CN: 弹出方向，缺省为 bottomLeft（RTL 下为 bottomRight）。
position.en-US: Popup position. Defaults to bottomLeft (bottomRight in RTL).

mouseEnterDelay.zh-CN: 指针移入后延迟显示的毫秒数，仅 trigger 为 hover 或 focus 时生效。
mouseEnterDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before it shows after the pointer enters. Applies to the hover and focus triggers.

mouseLeaveDelay.zh-CN: 指针移出后延迟隐藏的毫秒数，仅 trigger 为 hover 或 focus 时生效。
mouseLeaveDelay.en-US: Milliseconds before it hides after the pointer leaves. Applies to the hover and focus triggers.

trigger.zh-CN: 触发展示的时机，可选 hover、focus、click、contextMenu 或 custom。
trigger.en-US: When it shows: hover, focus, click, contextMenu or custom.

contentClassName.en-US: Class name of the content container.

spacing.zh-CN: 弹出层与触发元素的距离，单位为像素；对象形式分别设置水平与垂直方向。
spacing.en-US: Distance in pixels between the popup and the trigger. An object sets the horizontal and vertical distances.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的 click、mousedown 与焦点进出事件冒泡；确认卡片内的 click 始终不冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click, mousedown and focus in/out events on the popup stop propagating. Clicks inside the card never propagate.

arrowStyle.zh-CN: 箭头的边框色、背景色与边框透明度。
arrowStyle.en-US: Border color, background color and border opacity of the arrow.

arrowPointAtCenter.zh-CN: 箭头是否指向触发元素中心，需要同时开启 showArrow。
arrowPointAtCenter.en-US: Whether the arrow points at the center of the trigger. Requires showArrow.

prefixCls.en-US: Class prefix of the confirmation card.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 弹出层打开期间按 Esc 是否关闭确认框；trigger 为 custom 时只触发 escKeyDown，由使用方决定是否关闭。
closeOnEsc.en-US: Whether Esc closes the open card. With trigger custom it only emits escKeyDown and the caller decides whether to close.

guardFocus.zh-CN: 焦点位于确认框内时，Tab 是否在其中循环。
guardFocus.en-US: Whether Tab cycles inside the card while focus is in it.

returnFocusOnClose.zh-CN: 关闭后焦点是否回到触发元素；受控的 visible 也照常生效，trigger 为 custom 时不生效。
returnFocusOnClose.en-US: Whether focus returns to the trigger after closing. It also works with a controlled visible, and has no effect with trigger custom.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 点击弹出层及其内部任一元素时是否关闭。
clickToHide.en-US: Whether a click on the popup or anything inside it closes it.

disableArrowKeyDown.zh-CN: 是否禁用在触发元素上按方向键把焦点移入确认框。
disableArrowKeyDown.en-US: Whether the arrow keys on the trigger are prevented from moving focus into the card.

disableFocusListener.zh-CN: trigger 为 hover 时，是否不响应键盘聚焦打开。
disableFocusListener.en-US: Whether keyboard focus is ignored when trigger is hover.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留内容而不销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the content stays mounted while closed.

condition.zh-CN: 是否允许触发显示；仅显式设为 false 时，hover、click、focus 等触发行为不生效。由 true 变为 false 时立即关闭已显示的确认框；visible 受控时只发出 update:visible 与 visibleChange(false)，使用方回写后才关闭。
condition.en-US: Whether it may be triggered. Only an explicit false disables the hover, click and focus triggers. Changing it from true to false closes an open card at once; with a controlled visible it only emits update:visible and visibleChange(false), and the card closes once the caller writes back.

update:visible.zh-CN: 需要显示或隐藏时触发，供 v-model:visible 回写。
update:visible.en-US: Emitted when it should show or hide, for v-model:visible to write back.

visibleChange.zh-CN: 显示状态变化时触发；用户点击触发器后早于确认框出现。visible 受控时只报告用户交互发起的请求，父组件自己改变 visible 不触发。
visibleChange.en-US: Emitted when the visibility changes. After a click on the trigger it fires before the card appears. With a controlled visible it reports only requests from user interaction, not changes the parent makes to visible.

clickOutSide.zh-CN: 确认框打开时在触发元素与确认框以外的区域按下鼠标时触发，仅 trigger 为 click、contextMenu 或 custom 时有效。
clickOutSide.en-US: Emitted when the mouse is pressed outside of the trigger and the open card. Only for trigger click, contextMenu or custom.

escKeyDown.zh-CN: closeOnEsc 为 true（缺省）时，确认框打开期间按 Esc 触发。
escKeyDown.en-US: Emitted when Esc is pressed while the card is open and closeOnEsc is true (the default).

open.zh-CN: 确认框显示、进场动画开始时触发，每次打开一次，早于 afterOpen，受控与非受控相同；悬停打开后指针已离开而撤回的打开不触发。
open.en-US: Emitted once per opening when the card is shown, as its enter animation starts, before afterOpen, controlled or not; not emitted for a hover open withdrawn because the pointer already left.

afterOpen.zh-CN: 确认框打开且进场动画结束后触发；没有进场动画时打开后即触发，受控与非受控相同；进场结束前被关闭的打开不触发。
afterOpen.en-US: Emitted after the card has opened and its enter animation has finished, or right after opening when there is no enter animation, controlled or not; not emitted for an open that is closed before the enter animation ends.

afterClose.zh-CN: 确认框关闭且离场动画结束后触发。
afterClose.en-US: Emitted after the card has closed and its leave animation has finished.

content.zh-CN: 确认框内容，作用域参数 initialFocusRef 绑定到打开时需要聚焦的元素；空插槽不渲染内容区。
content.en-US: Content of the card. The scope parameter initialFocusRef binds to the element that receives focus on open. An empty slot renders no content area.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义图标；不传时显示默认警告图标，传入空插槽则不渲染图标。
icon.en-US: Custom icon. The default warning icon shows when omitted; an empty slot renders no icon.

focusTrigger.zh-CN: 让触发元素获得焦点，仅在 returnFocusOnClose 为 true 且 trigger 不是 custom 时生效；disabled 时调用无效果。
focusTrigger.en-US: Focuses the trigger. Only works when returnFocusOnClose is true and trigger is not custom; does nothing when disabled.
